name: PocketBase
notes: PocketBase is an open source backend with built-in SQLite database, authentication, file storage, and admin dashboard. The installer creates an initial superuser — log in at https://yourdomain.com/_/ with the credentials shown in your dashboard notice. Data lives in ~/apps/{app_name}/pb_data/. A cron watchdog runs every 2 minutes to keep the process alive; unexpected restarts are recorded in ~/logs/apps/{app_name}/watchdog.log.
